guide.title: How to use this assistant
guide.intro: Follow these steps from sign-in through chat to a readable planning summary report (not a sales offer).
guide.step1: Register or log in with your existing account.
guide.step2: Open Planning chat and start a session; explain family context, priorities, and rough budget cues in plain language.
guide.step3: Answer follow-up prompts — richer context yields a better summary.
guide.step4: When ready, open the report page to generate a summary; print or save as PDF. Product links come from attributed sources.
guide.step5: Use Product library for keyword or semantic search over public materials; Market insights shows indicators and refresh history.
guide.notice: Outputs are educational and informational only; they do not replace licensed individualized advice.
guide.referenceFooter: This walkthrough aligns with China Life Insurance (Overseas) Company Limited public-material scope; it does not solicit open-ended whole-of-market insurer comparisons.
